gaps.detail: The sealed first attempt has setup failure metadata but no underlying process/setup diagnostic; task, workspace, checkpoint, and tool IDs remain unobserved.

The bounded rerun built the pinned environment and probed gateway routes, but Windows subprocess capture failed before OpenHands task evidence was produced; no executable composition PASS is available.
The rerun image installed 232 distributions while the historical Phase 7 environment records 187; the rerun image is retained only as setup evidence and is not promoted to Phase 7 provenance.
